note: Thresholds are set BEFORE any real-model result exists and must not be changed afterwards. n is small (20 answers, 8 questions): results are exploratory, never general grading accuracy.

mechanical._scope: computable without human labels; evaluated by audit/evaluation/stage3c2_analyze.py

needs_human_labels._scope: cannot be evaluated until a person has completed the blind review sheet; until then these are reported as PENDING_HUMAN and no accuracy is claimed

decision_rule.all_mechanical_pass_and_human_labels_ava: ADVANCE: a larger human-labelled study of the modular verifier on the 16 eligible questions may be planned. Still no shadow mode or live scoring without a further explicit approval.
decision_rule.all_mechanical_pass_but_no_human_labels: EXPLORATORY ONLY: behavioural readiness can be reported; quality readiness cannot. Obtain human labels before any further step.
decision_rule.any_mechanical_fail: DO NOT ADVANCE: report which criterion failed and why. Do not tune the prompt, gate or rubric on these 20 answers and re-score them; any change requires a new sample.
decision_rule.any_human_criterion_fail: DO NOT ADVANCE: investigate failures; same no-retuning rule.
